trigger: The masked Plug grader asked whether the legacy supported_correct fact-status label conflates reference correctness and actual context support.
resolution: Fact assessments track frozen-reference semantic correctness. A reference-correct fact absent from received evidence can use supported_correct, with the absence stated explicitly in its rationale and assessed separately under citation_grounded and unsupported_assertions. The joint score still requires reference content, requested scope and actual citation support.
basis: The frozen scoring contract explicitly separates reference_content_correct from citation_grounded. This clarification preserves those axes and adds no reference facts or success criteria.
required_disclosure: Grade artifacts must explain that the legacy fact-status label alone does not certify support in received context.
